product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic is an enterprise content-orchestration platform combining digital and media asset management for large brands, archives, and government agencies.
product_one_liner.notes: Orange Logic’s About page describes a content-orchestration platform offering digital and media asset management for major brands, archives, and government agencies.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation lists product, solutions, customers, resources, partners, and about, with a demo call to action but no pricing link. The linked demo page asks users to submit contact/project details rather than presenting pricing; no official public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Orange Logic’s customer success stories name Lionsgate and Coty as customers. | named_customers.0: Orange Logic’s customer success story identifies Lionsgate as a customer. | named_customers.1: Orange Logic’s customer success story identifies Coty as a customer.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 278 employees; that count falls in the requested 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies its headquarters in Irvine, California; the city value is Irvine. | hq_country: The Orange Logic company profile identifies the country as the United States and its locality as Irvine, California.

founded_year.notes: The Orange Logic LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists its founded year as 1998.

eng_blog.notes: The Juice Bar is presented as a DAM blog with general DAM strategy and product/market posts in its index. The technical-architecture posts found on that blog identify Helen Shacklett as their author and Head of Content, rather than an engineer; the available evidence does not establish the two engineer-authored build-focused posts required for a technical engineering blog, so this is false.

public_docs.notes: Orange Logic publishes an OrangeDAM documentation index and a developer API reference containing multiple articles on authentication, API setup, and related topics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-positions list includes an Applied AI Product Engineer role, which meets the specified AI/ML job-title criterion.

model_provider.value: NVIDIA Nemotron open models are available in Agent Studio, which also supports customer-selected models.
model_provider.notes: Orange Logic’s announcement says Agent Studio is powered by NVIDIA Nemotron open models and that customers can choose the model suited to a task; its AI FAQ confirms Agent Studio is model-flexible.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Orange Logic’s security and compliance page explicitly names ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR among its certifications, regulations, and standards; these are the five requested labels. | compliance_certs.0: The Orange Logic security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Orange Logic security page explicitly names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The Orange Logic security page explicitly names PCI DSS. | compliance_certs.3: The Orange Logic security page explicitly names HIPAA. | compliance_certs.4: The Orange Logic security page explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding database identifies the latest round as PE, i.e. private equity. | funding_date: Tracxn identifies the latest PE round as May 16, 2023; the investor’s announcement independently dates the investment to May 16, 2023, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2023-05. | funding_amount_usd: The funding database reports a single PE round and says its amount is undisclosed; therefore the numeric amount is unknown and represented as null.

raised_18mo.notes: Tracxn’s profile identifies the latest funding as a PE round on May 16, 2023; Bregal’s announcement confirms the date. That is before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025, so the company did not raise in the requested period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Orange Logic’s direct job pages show Account Executive and Sales Development Representative postings with Apply now links. The central careers list did not display these two titles, so the direct postings support a positive answer but the list inconsistency leaves some uncertainty.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s news page dates the Orange Builder product announcement to September 30, 2026, within the six months preceding November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Orange Logic SDR job post names HubSpot as the preferred CRM, making it a visible CRM-stack signal. | crm_stack_signal.0: HubSpot is explicitly named as the preferred CRM in the job posting.
